verdict: Leads are flowing; Google spend needs to earn its place.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 150 leads at a cost of $17.24 per lead — all of them sourced from Meta. Google Ads ran $1,019 in spend across 171 clicks and returned zero confirmed leads; that budget is being reviewed this week and will not continue on its current footing. On the positive side, the most recent 7 days show cost per lead improving 8% even as volume normalised after a brief gap mid-period, which points to Meta efficiency holding up. The bigger issue right now is pipeline progression: 136 opportunities entered your system this period and none advanced to a won stage, which points to intake or follow-up rather than ad performance — we're working through that with you ahead of the full pipeline build completing August 31.
